description: Lists what the Farmland API actually holds: row counts and the year range for each dataset (land values and cash rents), the total number of distinct states and counties covered, and the state codes present in each dataset. Use before get_land_values or get_cash_rents to confirm a state or year is covered — the stored data is currently a single survey year, 2026 — or to size a query. Read-only; no API key. This mirrors the REST /v1/status summary and adds the per-dataset state lists. It takes no parameters.
name: list_coverage
